rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an unspecified future time.

example.english: We'll deal with this problem someday.
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 man6 tai4 dai6 si4 sin1 syun3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the future event is presented as something that will eventually happen.

example.jyutping: zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 ngo5 wui5 maai5 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use this for “one day” in the future, especially in a hopeful or aspirational statement.

example.english: Someday I definitely want to open a café.
example.traditional: 有日我一定要開間咖啡店。
example.jyutping: jau5 jat6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hoi1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3
